target_semantics_lesson: Forecast the monthly percentage change of the VIX index for January 2024, focusing on its directional movement and magnitude.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by ensuring current evidence directly measures each factor and supports every retained relationship edge.
causal_reasoning_lesson: A VIX topping signal suggests a potential rise. This must be weighed against historical S&P 500 flatness and its VIX correlation.
counterevidence_lesson: Historical S&P 500 flatness in January can temper VIX rise signals, especially if the magnitude of the VIX move is not precisely quantified.
calibration_lesson: Assess if current evidence supports magnitude and boundary crossing, not just direction, and if any counter-path dominates the leading supported path.
